panels.title: Active vs. expected detector threads
panels.description: A sustained gap between active and expected is the direct, dashboard-visible version of the 2-cameras-stuck-reconnecting pattern on jaeil_cr's second NVR unit.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: This is the metric that would have shown the jaeil_cr fd-leak climbing for hours before the SIGSEGV/GLib-abort crash. A steadily climbing, non-resetting trend on any one site is the thing to act on before it crashes.

panels.title: Container restarts (per site, over dashboard range)
panels.description: Sourced from cAdvisor's container_start_time_seconds via changes() -- a new start time after a crash/restart counts as a change. cAdvisor's container name label format may need adjusting to match what a live deployment actually reports; verify against real scrape output before relying on this panel.

panels.title: Dynamic-config freshness (seconds since last successful fetch)
panels.description: Dynamic method only -- the direct, dashboard-visible answer to "is config_renew_period actually firing". No data for static-method sites is expected, not a gap.
